tax_year.rationale: CalendarYr directly maps to the calendar tax year printed at the top of the form.

void.rationale: No VoidInd or equivalent element exists in the candidate list; the schema does not appear to include a VOID checkbox element.

corrected.rationale: CorrectedInd directly maps to the CORRECTED checkbox at the top of the form.

payer_name.rationale: BusinessNameLine1Txt under PayerName is the primary payer name line; blueprint bundles both name lines into one string but canonical splits into Line1 and Line2 — ideally blueprint should split into payer_name_line1 and payer_name_line2 matching idx 17 and 18.

payer_street_address.rationale: PayerUSAddress (idx 20) is a group element, not a leaf; the canonical schema splits the address into sub-elements not individually listed in the candidates, so no leaf-level match is available for street address alone.

payer_city.rationale: No CityNm leaf under PayerUSAddress is present in the candidate list; blueprint should map to PayerUSAddress/CityNm once the schema sub-elements are exposed.

payer_state.rationale: No StateAbbreviationCd leaf under PayerUSAddress is present in the candidate list; blueprint should map to PayerUSAddress/StateAbbreviationCd once exposed.

payer_zip.rationale: No ZIPCd leaf under PayerUSAddress is present in the candidate list; blueprint should map to PayerUSAddress/ZIPCd once exposed.

payer_phone.rationale: PhoneNum maps to the payer's telephone number printed below the payer address block.

payer_tin.rationale: PayerEIN maps to the PAYER'S TIN box on the form.

recipient_tin.rationale: RecipientSSN is the closest leaf for the RECIPIENT'S TIN box, though the canonical schema also has RecipientEIN (idx 23); blueprint bundles both into one field while canonical splits by TIN type — blueprint should split into recipient_ssn and recipient_ein to align with the canonical shape.

recipient_name.rationale: RecipientNm directly maps to the RECIPIENT'S name box on the form.

recipient_street_address.rationale: AddressLine1Txt under RecipientUSAddress maps to the recipient's street address line.

recipient_city.rationale: No CityNm leaf under RecipientUSAddress is present in the candidate list; blueprint should map to RecipientUSAddress/CityNm once the schema sub-elements are exposed.

recipient_state.rationale: No StateAbbreviationCd leaf under RecipientUSAddress is present in the candidate list; blueprint should map to RecipientUSAddress/StateAbbreviationCd once exposed.

recipient_zip.rationale: No ZIPCd leaf under RecipientUSAddress is present in the candidate list; blueprint should map to RecipientUSAddress/ZIPCd once exposed.

account_number.rationale: RecipientAccountNum directly maps to the ACCOUNT NUMBER box on the form.

fatca_filing_requirement.rationale: No FATCAFilingRequirementInd or equivalent element appears in the candidate list for this form.

nonemployee_compensation.rationale: NonemployeeCompensationAmt directly maps to Box 1 — Nonemployee compensation.

payer_made_direct_sales.rationale: DirectSaleAboveThresholdInd maps to the Box 2 checkbox for direct sales of $5,000 or more.

federal_income_tax_withheld.rationale: FederalIncomeTaxWithheldAmt directly maps to Box 4 — Federal income tax withheld.

state_tax_lines.rationale: Blueprint bundles Boxes 5–7 into an array of state tax rows while the canonical schema uses a repeating Form1099NECStateLocalTaxGrp group (idx 6) containing StateAbbreviationCd, StateIdNum, StateTaxWithheldAmt, StateIncomeAmt, LocalTaxWithheldAmt, LocalIncomeAmt, and LocalityNm as individual leaf elements — blueprint should be refactored into per-row structured objects mapping to idx 10–13 (and 7–9 for local) rather than a single array field.
